what: The twelve Olympus art filters unchanged; film simulations loaded from the SD card with Custom Menu J, Load Looks, overwrite the entries the file lists, without Natural's selective colour changes on top, are applied at power-on before the first picture, and a photo taken with one records the film's name (EXIF ImageDescription); interval shooting with up to 240 frames, a level gauge with calibration that keeps the shooting information of the histogram screen (as the PEN-F does), and focus peaking, which in MF shows the lines in the normal live view the whole time (no magnified view needed, with any lens) and with MF Assist when the focus ring turns; a Debug Log row in Custom Menu J (Off by default) that writes EPM2LOG.BIN to the card for developers; a Lowest S/S Setting row in Custom Menu E (the shutter speed at which ISO Auto starts to rise in P and A); spot metering at the AF target: Custom Menu E, Spot Metering, has an On/Off row each for Spot, Spot Hilight and Spot Shadow (all Off by default); a variant set to On meters at the AF point set by a touch on the screen, or else at the selected AF target in single-target AF; Light Box, as on the E-M10 and later bodies: Custom Menu D, ▶/Info Settings, ▶ Info has a Light Box row (Off by default); with it On, INFO in playback shows two pictures side by side, to compare them, and the control dial zooms both one step per detent; RAW Data Edit has an ART BKT row, which develops a RAW once in the current Picture Mode and once per film simulation or art filter that is On in Shooting Menu 2, Bracketing, ART BKT, each as its own JPEG that records its film's name (EXIF ImageDescription); the names of the added menu rows read the same in every menu language; the Firmware screen shows the build's label (Body : 1.6  EPM2Mod 2026.12.02)

boot_differs.why: The stabilizer is not started, so its fault report (error 0x8228 in the emulator) and the settings save that goes with it do not happen; 'BS.' is printed with that save
A buffer address of the file task's first command is 0x300 lower: the stabilizer start's memory is not allocated
